title: Reject rollouts when independent traces disagree
narrative: Nubble needs executor events and gateway capture to reconcile before a rollout is accepted for training or self-improvement. Accepts FineEnvs independent trajectory checks[^fineenvs-reconcile].
implementation: `ObservationSurface`, `reconcile_traces`, and `require_reconciled` in `mechaharness.trace_reconciliation` compare event ids and digests across surfaces.
validation: Kind `trace_reconciliation_check`. Soft expects conflict status. Unit tests in `tests/test_trace_reconciliation.py`.
